platforms.description: Current-generation KTM-group 4-stroke MX/XC platform (250/350/450). Per KTM's Manfred Edlinger, 2026 is the 4th year of the current full-size SX generation, so it began MY2023. 2026 changes were minor (fuel-link protector cap, radiator cap, styling). Includes 2022.5 KTM 450 SX-F Factory Edition and Husqvarna FC450 Rockstar Edition, which aftermarket fitment lists group with 2023+.

Sub-revision inside ktm-4t-mx-2023: KTM PowerParts notes say EU MY26, US MY26 Factory Edition and US MY27 standard SX-F/XC-F models have a changed airbox and air filter. To run the Akrapovic exhausts these must be reverted to MY25 parts plus the correct engine map, and in that configuration the bikes no longer meet the 109 dB FIM limit. Aftermarket filter/exhaust fitment for these bikes needs checking.
platforms.models_years: EU MY2026 SX-F/XC-F; US MY2026 SX-F Factory Edition; US MY2027 standard SX-F/XC-F (and likely matching Husqvarna/GasGas, unverified)

platforms.description: KTM-group 250/300 2-stroke with throttle-body injection (TBI, Keihin EFI), with a 2-position map switch (green and white). Started MY2023 on KTM SX/XC and Husqvarna TC250/TX300; GasGas moved to the platform for MY2024, when its MX 2-strokes dropped carburetors.

MY2027 small-bore 2-stroke goes fuel-injected. KTM says the 2027 125 SX has Keihin EFI, an electronic power valve and a 2-map switch. A Spanish report says the 2027 Husqvarna TC125, TC250 and TC300 all have TBI. Throttle body size and airbox details are not stated. Carburetor parts for 2023-2026 125/150 SX do not carry over.
platforms.models_years: KTM 125 SX 2027; Husqvarna TC125 2027 (per press report); GasGas MC125 2027 (unverified)

platforms.description: New-generation 85 SX. Per Edlinger, 2026 is the 2nd year, so it began MY2025. Carbureted with a Keihin PWK 28. 2026 change was only a 2-position brake lever. Aftermarket pipes listed for 2018-2024 85s are not confirmed for 2025+.

products.product: Factory 4.1 RCT Titanium Anodized Full System w/ Carbon End Cap, KTM/Husqvarna 450 SX-F/FC 2023-2026
products.variants: Titanium MegaBomb header, titanium mid pipe, blue-anodized titanium muffler, carbon end cap; includes a spark-arrestor screen insert and a 94 dB quiet insert. MXA says a stainless mid-pipe/muffler combo also exists. The TokyoMods SKU 'A48005979003_and_A48005907500' looks like a KTM PowerParts-style number and is NOT a confirmed FMF part number.
products.what_it_changes: FMF claim: resonance chamber technology, shorter muffler for mass centralization. MXA (2023) measured no dyno numbers vs stock.
products.supporting_parts: Removable muffler insert: MXA found more midrange with it out, but crisper hit with it in.

rider_feedback.author: MXA staff
rider_feedback.summary: Racier sound, noticeably snappier initial throttle in loamy corners, more bottom power (easier to carry 3rd in tight turns). Top end no stronger than stock with the insert in; insert out gave more midrange but less crisp response, and most testers raced with it in. No complaints. MXA prices: Ti complete system $1,249.99, Ti mid-pipe/muffler $799.99, Ti head pipe $449.99.
rider_feedback.conditions: 2023 KTM 450SXF; stock bike described as close to 60 hp; no back-to-back dyno published
